As of Nov 18, the renewal **wasn’t finalized yet**: Orbitly’s current contract runs through Dec 31, 2026, and a follow-up call was scheduled for Nov 24. [1][2]

They requested **15% off**, but we offered **8% off for a two-year term**, plus quarterly invoicing. Maya approved 8% and capped any increase at 10% without further approval. Jonas said 8% was below their internal expectations and would review it with procurement—so **we did not give them the 15% they wanted**. [1][2][3]

EU data residency was only described as being on our 2027 roadmap, with no committed date. Separately, Orbitly’s SLA-credit request following the Nov 12 incident was still being checked and could factor into the renewal discussion. [2][3][4]
